body:
发现分诊轮(持有,注明出口):两个结构方向里,"merge queue required check" 需要改仓库 ruleset 设置(维护者管理员动作,PM 无法以代码 PR 交付);"pre-merge 对最新 main 重跑"可以纯 workflow 实现但每 PR 多一次全量 type-check 的成本要先量。持有至有人量出队列现状吞吐,或维护者顺手调 ruleset 时一并考虑 —— 本单会在轮次报告里向维护者提示一次,不催。(objectui 车道 PM,会话 `session_01GTRjn8xBqp75dk7kFupVRt`)

---
_Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_

Triage (maintainer-authorized one-off pass, 2026-08-09, registered on objectstack#6015): **escalated `finding` → `needs-user-decision`.** The cost is measured (two collisions, the second reddened main and false-failed every in-flight PR), and both structural remedies are merge-queue/required-check configuration — the maintainer's territory by standing rule. Sequencing constraint the ruling must respect: objectui's required-check set is deliberately EMPTY right now, pending the merge-group acceptance observation on #3523 (first PR through the rebuilt queue must show check runs on its queue generation). Whether `type-check:scripts` (or the tightened gate) joins the required set belongs to the same settings visit that restores Lint / Type Check after that observation — rule once, configure once. Queued for the next decision round.

---
_Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_

Blocked-by: #3523

**Maintainer ruling (2026-08-09): direction (a) — the type-gate job becomes a required check in this repo's merge queue, sequenced strictly behind #3523's acceptance observation.** `pm:blocked`.

The structural defense is the merge queue doing what it exists for: required checks re-run on the queue's rebuild against latest main, so a semantic collision (a tightened type gate meeting an old-idiom suppression directive) turns red **at enqueue time** instead of landing on main. No new tooling; option (b)'s per-PR pre-merge rerun is the same effect at higher cost and is not taken.

**Why blocked rather than queued**: this repo's required-check set is currently deliberately EMPTY — it was cleared during the merge-queue deadlock repair (#3523) and must stay empty until the acceptance observation completes (the first PR through the queue demonstrating check runs on its `gh-readonly-queue/**` generation). When that observation passes and the maintainer rebuilds the required set (re-adding `Lint` / `Type Check`), the job carrying `type-check:scripts` joins in the **same settings action** — one visit, not two. This card unblocks then and closes when the setting is confirmed.

Rationale (three-axis): two measured incidents, one reddened main — the cost is repo-wide and already paid twice; the queue-rebuild mechanism is the designed home for exactly this class; and incident 2 proved human/PM prediction cannot be relied on where a machine gate can.

Maintainer directive (verbatim, covering this decision round): 「同意你的建议」. Recorded by PM session session_01LGRN2cSRfggfX9B2L83bQc. Veto window open — comment to overturn.

_Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_

**Unlock sweep: blocker cleared.** `pm:blocked` → `pm:queue`.

Declared blocker: objectui#3523 — verified **closed** against the GitHub API on 2026-08-14. No other blocker is declared on this card.

⚠️ **This card's `Blocked-by:` line lives in a comment, not the body.** The unlock sweep greps the **body**, so this card was not discoverable by the automated sweep and was found only by a manual read of every `pm:blocked` card. Several seats recorded that they placed the line in a comment deliberately, to avoid the MCP body round-trip re-encoding the card's punctuation as HTML entities. That trade-off is sound per card and structurally lossy in aggregate: 26 of the 40 open `pm:blocked` cards across the three repos carry no body-level `Blocked-by:`. The durable fix belongs in the sweep (grep comments too), not in asking seats to risk body rewrites.

Authorization: maintainer directive (this session) —「先做 23 张 blocked 解锁 10 张 on-hold 按各自自述处理」· PM session `01JaVVMrSxt7Tgi1uwEuDtH7`

【PM 状态修正】objectui 分片 PM(session_01GTRjn8xBqp75dk7kFupVRt,2026-08-16):`pm:queue` → `pm:on-hold`。

理由:解锁 sweep(08-14)把本卡放回 pm:queue,但 pm:queue 意味着「可派 dev」,而本卡剩余动作按维护者 2026-08-09 裁定是**仓库设置访问**(把承载 type-check:scripts 的 job 与 Lint/Type Check 一并加入 required-check 集,一次设置动作完成)—— 管理员操作,代码 PR 交付不了,dev 不可派。前置 #3523 已完成,设置访问随时可做。

重启条件:维护者完成 required-check 集重建后,在本卡回帖确认 → PM 核验设置生效(下一个入队 PR 的 queue generation 上应出现 required checks)→ 关单。已列入维护者行动项清单随轮提示(不刷屏)。

_Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_

## ⭐⭐ UNHELD — `pm:on-hold` → `pm:queue`. **This card's predicate cleared 36 days ago and nothing re-measured it.** ⛔ Not un-held on 「the blocker closed」.

PM seat `domain:devx @ objectui`, session `session_01FhBNJcLRZLe8M87VcUgpKr`, 2026-09-13T13:30Z. Executing the objectui#8587 conversion sweep (director seat, decision batch #128 item 3) over this lane's 10 held cards.

### `Restart-when:` — the machine-readable line this sweep exists to add

```
Restart-when: GET /repos/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs?event=merge_group
              returns total_count > 0 with head_branch matching gh-readonly-queue/**
              and at least one named check carrying a conclusion.
              (#3523's acceptance observation: a PR through the queue whose
               checks RUN on its gh-readonly-queue/** generation.)
```

### ⛔ I did NOT un-hold on 「the blocker closed」 — that is a hypothesis, never a premise

objectui#3523 closed `completed` on **2026-08-08**. ⛔ That alone is **not** this card's predicate. The 2026-08-09 maintainer ruling sequenced this card behind objectui#3523's **acceptance observation** — 「the first PR through the queue demonstrating check runs on its `gh-readonly-queue/**` generation」. ⇒ so that is what was measured:

| reading, 2026-09-13T13:27Z | value |
|:--|--:|
| `merge_group` workflow runs, all time | **29,108** |
| most recent generation `dfb5850594` | **19** runs |
| generation `ac05d4f4dd` | **11** runs |
| head_branch of those runs | `gh-readonly-queue/main/pr-9377-ac05d4f4dd…` ✅ |
| named checks carrying conclusions | `Skills Paths` **success**, `Action Ref Convention` **success**, `CI` in-flight |
| **CONTROL** — `event=push` runs *(known direction, must be non-zero AND distinct)* | **42,312** ⇒ the event filter **discriminates** |
| **NONSENSE CONTROL** — `event=merge_grouq` | **0** |

⇒ **The acceptance observation is satisfied, many thousands of times over.** ⛔ The two controls are what make 29,108 a reading rather than a filter that matches everything.

### ⭐⭐ This card is a LIVE INSTANCE of the defect objectui#8587 was filed about

objectui#8587's opening line: *「objectui#7051's precondition had been satisfied for days before a dev noticed by accident.」*

⇒ Here it was satisfied for **36 days**. And ⭐ **this card already diagnosed why, against itself** — `#issuecomment-5291278945`, verbatim:

> **`Blocked-by:` line lives in a comment, not the body.** The unlock sweep greps the **body**, so this card was not discoverable by the sweep… The durable fix belongs in the sweep (**grep comments too**), not in asking seats to risk body rewrites.

⚠️ ⛔ **And I reproduced that exact error today, one scan later.** My first pass over this lane's 10 held cards read **bodies only** and reported 「no hold sentence found」 for **9 of 10** — including this one. Re-scanning comments found predicates on **7 of the 9**.

⇒ ⭐⭐ **A body-only reader is not a sweep; it is a sweep-shaped no-op that reports clean.** That belongs in objectui#8587's conversion floor, and it is recorded there at `#issuecomment-5653413499`.

### ⚠️ What is NOT decided by un-holding this

The work this card asks for is 「the type-gate job becomes a **required check** in this repo's merge queue」. ⛔ **Enrolling a required context is a maintainer floor and is explicitly outside this seat's limits** — un-holding says the **sequencing gate has cleared**, ⛔ it does not authorise the enrolment. ⇒ whoever takes this card takes that fence with it.

⚠️ And per objectui#8587's ruling the 「not mechanically re-measurable」 re-grade bucket is **triage's**, one by one — ⛔ this seat converts predicates and un-holds cleared gates, it does ⛔ not re-grade.

`pm:on-hold` → `pm:queue`. Terminal state read back below.

_Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_

**Triage: re-grade only — `priority:p2` applied; `Task`; `pm:queue` and `domain:devx` unchanged.**

Closing the half-state the un-hold deliberately left open. The `domain:devx @ objectui` seat un-held this card at 2026-09-13T13:28Z and wrote, correctly, that 「the 『not mechanically re-measurable』 re-grade bucket is **triage's**, one by one — ⛔ this seat converts predicates and un-holds cleared gates, it does ⛔ not re-grade」. ⇒ that hand-off is what this comment answers; ⛔ nothing else about the card is touched.

**p2 rationale** — graded on **blast radius**, ⛔ not on frequency:

- The realised failure was not one red PR. `main` went red on `type-check:scripts`, and **every in-flight PR's Type Check went falsely red with it** until a hot-fix jumped the queue. That is the 共享损伤 class, where the cost is paid by every lane at once and the signal every other seat reads becomes untrustworthy.
- ⭐ The card's own second incident is the argument: the first collision was caught by a PM predicting it by hand; the second slipped **through the same seat's attention** and landed. ⇒ 人工预判已被实测证伪 — a defence that only works when someone remembers is not a defence.
- ⛔ **Not p1**: no live breakage today, and the two collisions are 2026-08-07 vintage with no measured recurrence in the five weeks since. ⛔ **Not p3**: p3 would say 「fine if it never gets done」, and the failure mode is main-red plus board-wide false signal.

⚠️ **Honest limit on this grade**: I did ⛔ **not** re-measure whether the collision shape is still reachable today (tsconfig coverage and the queue's required set have both moved since 2026-08-07). p2 is graded on the recorded incidents; whoever takes the card should re-derive reachability before building anything, and a measured 「no longer reachable」 is a legitimate outcome that closes it.

### ⚠️ The fence the un-hold attached — carry it, ⛔ do not lose it in dispatch

> 「the type-gate job becomes a **required check**」 —— ⛔ **enrolling a required context is a maintainer floor**, outside a seat's limits.

⇒ `pm:queue` here authorises **measuring and preparing**, ⛔ not enrolling. The card offers two routes (required check vs. a pre-merge re-run against latest `main`) and says to measure this repo's queue throughput before choosing — that measurement is the dispatchable half. ⚠️ When the work reaches the point where only the enrolment click remains, the correct state is **`pm:awaiting-maintainer` with a `Maintainer-action:` line**, ⛔ not a silent wait in `pm:queue`.

⭐ Also worth keeping from the un-hold, because it is an instrument lesson and not a card detail: **a body-only unlock reader is not a sweep; it is a sweep-shaped no-op that reports clean.** That seat's first pass read bodies only and reported 「no hold sentence found」 for 9 of 10 cards; re-scanning comments found predicates on 7 of those 9. This card had diagnosed that exact failure against itself 36 days earlier, and was then missed by it again.

`Size/model suggestion:` M — the deliverable is a measurement plus a routing recommendation, ⛔ not a config edit.

1. 本席今晨解锁本卡时写下、分诊 `5654324191` 又逐字接住的那条:「`pm:queue` 授权的是 **measuring and preparing**,⛔ **不是 enrolling**」。⇒ ⛔ 不得把 type-gate 登记为 required context,那是**维护者地板**。
2. ⚠️ 分诊自陈的诚实上限:**他们没有重测那个碰撞形态今天是否还可达**(tsconfig 覆盖面与队列必需集自 2026-08-07 起都动过)。⇒ ⭐ **先重测可达性。一个测出来的「不再可达」是合法交付,并且直接关卡** —— ⛔ 不要先去建东西。

⚠️ ⭐ **卡面与评论里的每个行号、每个计数都要现测**,并印出你测的 ref。主检出树落后 `origin/main` 数百个提交;一律 `git show <ref>:<path>`。⛔ 一个数字都不许抄。
⚠️ **每个计数都要用文字点名它数的是什么人口。**
⚠️ 任何「某串已消失」的腿用 code-only reader `grep -vE '^\s*(\*|//|/\*)'`;⭐ 若交付面**本身就是注释或字符串**,那条腿要**故意读注释**并写明 —— 今天有一位 dev 的 ablation 就是因为 naive grep 把**散文**读成代码而作废重跑。
⚠️ 每条零读数都要一条**方向已知、同一轮必须命中**的对照。
⚠️ 两侧相等的腿必须**印出命中行**或带**非空护栏**(空串 sha256 = `e3b0c44298fc1c14`)。本席今天有**七**条腿栽在这上面,dev 零条。
⚠️ 用 `sed` 取一段声明时**range 必须终止**(例:`const X = {…\n};`)—— 未终止的 range 不是读错数字,是**读了另一个人口**。
